sources.title: Agent TARS - Open-source Multimodal AI Agent Stack
sources.snippet: Agent TARS is a general multimodal AI Agent stack, it brings the power of GUI Agent and Vision into your terminal, computer, browser and product. It primarily ships with a CLI and Web UI for usage. It aims to provide a workflow that is closer to human-like task completion through cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and seamless integration with various real-world MCP tools.
